game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Stump Court, a court around a giant stump: the wood elf archer must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the wood elf archer moves exactly n steps toward the herb garden.
theme: Mystic Forest – Stump Court: a court around a giant stump
core_gameplay_loop: In Stump Court, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the wood elf archer moves exactly n steps toward the herb garden. Each round, a new glowing seeds challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 290 points of glowing seeds by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Stump Court'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Stump Court.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
